title: Advertising Agency for Wedding Venues & Vendors

facts.fact: The page states that 85% of wedding searches now begin online, with Google Ads driving the majority of clicks for wedding services (no source is cited).
facts.quote: 85% of wedding searches now begin online, with Google Ads driving the majority of clicks for wedding services

facts.fact: The page states that 70% of Gen Z relies on social media and online research when planning their weddings, rather than traditional referrals (no source is cited).
facts.quote: 70% of Gen Z relies on social media and online research when planning their weddings, rather than traditional referrals

facts.fact: The page claims that Retargeting Ads on Meta (Instagram & Facebook) are 40% more effective in reaching engaged couples (no source is cited).
facts.quote: Retargeting Ads on Meta (Instagram & Facebook) are 40% more effective in reaching engaged couples

facts.fact: The agency's own marketing copy says its ads could bring ten to one hundred additional leads into a sales funnel each month; this is an aspirational vendor claim, not a guaranteed result.
facts.quote: Imagine ten to one hundred additional leads flowing into your sales funnel each month like clockwork

facts.fact: Wedding Industry Ads describes itself as a boutique advertising agency for venues and wedding professionals, focused on Google and Meta advertising.
facts.quote: Helping Small Business Owners in the Wedding Industry Grow with Strategic Advertising on Google & Meta

facts.fact: The page states that Wedding Industry Ads is co-founded by Daniela and Whitney, and that they are also co-founders of LeadLock.
facts.quote: CO-FOUNDERS OF WEDDING INDUSTRY ADS & LEADLOCK
